en: The coloured water for the Splash Parade got mixed up! Sort each colour into its own bucket.
Tap a bucket, then tap another to pour. You can only pour onto the same colour, or into an empty bucket.
Smoky layers (?) show their colour when you uncover them.
Solve it in few moves for 3 stars (undo is free, but undone moves still count). Every win unlocks a new level, forever.
